The '''Hoylin system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Fei Hu sector/Legends|Fei Hu sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoylin]].
